snippets.title: Four-stream source segregation
snippets.text: The framework used by VYARTHX is four-stream segregation at source: wet waste, dry waste, sanitary waste and special-care waste. Exact accepted materials and collection instructions are configured by the local authority. Interface colours in VYARTHX are illustrative and not a nationally mandated bag-colour standard.

snippets.title: Wet waste
snippets.text: Biodegradable kitchen and garden waste. Goes to composting, vermicomposting or biomethanation. Keep it free of plastic, glass and metal.

snippets.title: Dry waste
snippets.text: Clean recyclables and non-biodegradable dry items: paper, cardboard, plastics, metals, glass, textiles. Keep dry and reasonably clean so materials remain recoverable.

snippets.title: Sanitary waste
snippets.text: Diapers, sanitary pads, used masks and similar items. Wrap securely and hand over in the sanitary stream; do not mix with wet or dry waste.

snippets.title: Special-care waste
snippets.text: Items that can harm people or the environment if mixed: batteries, CFL and tube lights, expired medicines, paint and chemical containers, mercury devices, sharps and e-waste. Use authorised collection only.

snippets.title: E-waste handling
snippets.text: Do not dismantle, burn or acid-strip electronics at home. Hand over to authorised e-waste collectors or recyclers; repair and reuse come first where possible.

snippets.title: Medicine disposal
snippets.text: Do not flush or burn expired medicines. Use an authorised take-back or special-care collection channel where available.

snippets.title: Broken glass
snippets.text: Wrap broken glass in thick paper, label it and hand over in dry waste so workers are not injured.

snippets.title: Contamination
snippets.text: Food-soiled paper and plastics are often rejected by recyclers. Rinse containers lightly and separate soiled portions; follow local acceptance rules.

snippets.title: Worker safety
snippets.text: Workers should use gloves and closed footwear, never reach into mixed bags with bare hands, and escalate sharps, chemicals and unknown containers instead of handling them.

snippets.title: Reuse before recycling
snippets.text: Reuse, repair and donation keep products in use longer than recycling. List usable furniture, clothes, books and electronics before discarding.

snippets.title: Event waste
snippets.text: Events should place paired collection points for wet, dry-recyclable and reject streams, brief volunteers, and record recovery with a collection partner.

snippets.title: What VYARTHX will not do
snippets.text: VYARTHX never declares hazardous waste safe, never instructs home processing of hazardous items, and always routes special-care waste to authorised handling.
